$comment: SSOT for the process.env read ratchet (#2192 slice 5a). Consumed by tests/scripts/env-read-allowlist.test.ts (authoritative, lexical line-grain) and eslint-rules/require-env-justification.mjs (advisory warn mirror). Every migration car edits this file exactly as it edited the in-test literal before. allowedUnmarkedSites = the file's full pinned count until the 5b marker sweep flips per-site markers on.

rows.reason: SSOT env→typed-RuntimeConfig conversion seam; every read is instance-config→env→default. Includes the bot-errors publish bridge (#2192 slices 3a+3b): conditional WRITES + post-publish reads for BOT_ERRORS_{JID,EXPECTED_JID,REQUIRE_EXPECTED,SAFE_SHAPE_CRED_PATH} and EMIT_ALERT_THROTTLE_MS, + the BOT_ERRORS_RUNTIME_TOOL_FAILURE_ALERTS read behind toolFailureAlertsEnabled, + WHATSOUP_BAILEYS_VERSION absorbed as baileysVersionPinned (#2192 s4a — baileys-version.ts entry retired), + the four WHATSOUP_PROVIDER_FALLBACK_* tunables absorbed as fallbackTunables via one dynamic-key resolver line (#2192 s4b — runtime-tunables 6->2).

param-default `env` seam (WHATSOUP_REPO_ROOT) — env-late by design (#2192 s4 verdict: deploy-wrapper assertion input; the resolver VALIDATES env-vs-module-location agreement, so config-sourcing it would be self-referential).
build-time injected WHATSOUP_GIT_SHA / WHATSOUP_GIT_BRANCH (deploy hook, no typed source).
guard `env: … = process.env` DI seam — keeps the guard unit-testable.
bounded MCP key-list passthrough (.map over an explicit key list).

WHATSOUP_INTERNAL_JIDS env-late; BOT_ERRORS_JID config-published (#2192 slice 3a — config resolves the instance override and writes it back to process.env, so this call-time read needs no config import).
INSTANCE_CONFIG WRITE — multi-instance bootstrap protocol.
guard `env: … = process.env` DI seam — keeps the guard unit-testable.
bounded poll-target env lookup (per-name).
bounded path env-key lookup.

WHATSOUP_DOCKER_ENV + PATH ambient platform detection; WHATSOUP_NODE is env-late by design (#2192 s4 verdict: set by deploy wrappers in the GENERATING shell, host-level and pre-instance — a config import would couple the platform detector to config's load-time side effects).
bounded credential-presence env check (envKey !== undefined guard).
deliberate ops-token presence scan (Object.entries over process.env).
VITEST / VITEST_POOL_ID / VITEST_WORKER_ID test-runner detection.
TMPDIR + INSTANCE_CONFIG WRITES — multi-instance bootstrap protocol.
secret resolver W-3 env fallback (process.env[opts.envVar]) — must stay env-late.

outbox config group (BOT_ERRORS_*) + VITEST detection + TMPDIR (env-late by design: lib cannot import config, and config WRITES TMPDIR at load — the env var is the sanctioned lib-side channel). SAFE_SHAPE_CRED_PATH is config-published (#2192 slice 3b); the DIR/test/identity vars stay env-late (absence semantics feed vitest isolation + outbox provenance policy).

BOT_ERRORS_{JID,EXPECTED_JID,REQUIRE_EXPECTED} + EMIT_ALERT_THROTTLE_MS config-published (#2192 slices 3a+3b — TMPDIR pattern; validation and the call-time throttle getter stay here). WHATSOUP_ALERT_SINK stays env-late: verifier dial (#2510), injected out-of-band at runtime.
FLEET_HEALTH_VERIFY_GATE rollout enum (off/shadow/warn/enforce) — env-late by design: lib cannot import config, and the dial must flip live without a restart during staged fleet rollouts.
build-meta env lookup (bounded key list, git identity).
INSTANCE_CONFIG read — bootstrap protocol (pairs with config.ts:450).

secret resolver + REQUIRE_OS_KEYRING flag + XDG ambient — resolver stays env-late. Fifth site: lookupEnvCredential, the env-only read for values that are authoritative by contract (launcher-provenanced health token).

CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR — env-late by design (#2192 s4 verdict: external-tool interop; must track the env the spawned claude CLI sees, and the vitest isolation setup deletes it — env is the sanctioned channel).

env-late by design (#2192 slice 3c): BOT_ERRORS_STATE_DIR absence selects the XDG default (absence load-bearing); XDG_DATA_HOME is OS-ambient; WHATSOUP_INSTANCE is deploy-injected identity (systemd/launchd), never set in src.
bootstrap-early logger (LOG_LEVEL/LOG_DIR/VITEST) — cannot import config (eval-order cycle).
preflight import probe (2) — remaining after the slice-2 migrations.
memory-write API key resolver — must stay env-late (secret surface).
whole-object process.env → resolveReleaseIdentity (build/release identity).
pure resolver `env: Env = process.env` param-default (handoff-distill-config idiom).
exemplar pure resolver `env: Env = process.env` param-defaults — the idiom to extend.
passes env into the pure resolver at the call boundary (not a bypass).
child-env forward for canary probe (explicit allow-list of ambient vars).
child-env builder: explicit allow-list, not passthrough — highest-leak-risk seam.
VITEST/NODE_ENV detection + `deps.env ?? process.env` DI seam.
child-env forward (HOME/PATH/USER/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) for usability adapters.
envPositiveInt dynamic-key helper (session/system tunables) + diagnosticBundleEnabled call-time flag. The four PROVIDER_FALLBACK_* tunables are config-absorbed (#2192 s4b — fallbackTunables).

RESPONSE_REGISTRY_DISPATCH + DIAGNOSTIC_BUNDLE — env-late by design (#2192 s4 verdict: staged-rollout dial pair, live-flip semantics; the fleet-health-gate ground applies — transitional flags, typed-field investment would be throwaway).
child-env forward (HOME/PATH/USER/CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) for the auth-status probe.
positiveIntEnv dynamic-key helper + CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR ambient (gemini keys migrated in slice-1).
MW_MIND_RUN_ID external-subsystem per-run id (read 3×, same value).
transcription model/python — env-late by design (#2192 s4 verdict: host-local toolchain; PYTHON absence drives the managed-venv auto-probe chain, so absence is load-bearing).
PATH ambient executable lookup.
transcription model/bin — env-late by design (#2192 s4 verdict: host-level model path + explicit binary override, ambient toolchain).

WHATSOUP_PAIR_NUMBER — env-late by design (#2192 s4 verdict: per-CLI-run mode selector (QR vs pairing-code) + operator PII; a typed field would persist E.164 at rest and make an ephemeral per-run choice permanent).
bounded relay env key lookup.
